item.title: Campfire Blamed for Sparking Blaze that Destroyed Railroad Bridge in Lincoln, NE
item.description: The bridge that was nearly 100 years old was made of heavy timber, Lincoln fire officials reported.

item.title: Back to Drawing Board for Contractor, City over Fayetteville, NC, Fire Station Project
item.description: A city-hired consultant recommended that the Fayetteville station be demolished after finding several flaws.

item.title: When Is It Time to Step Down as the Volunteer Fire Chief?

item.title: House Explosion Leaves Mom, Child Seriously Burned in Taunton, MA
item.description: The mother went back into the burning house to save her child, Taunton Fire Chief Steven Lavigne said.

item.description: Seasoned officers that pulled the plugs on their careers in Farmington include captains and several chiefs.

item.title: Two Boonville, NY, Firefighters Hurt in Church Blast Still Critical
item.description: Fire Chief David Pritchard and a minister also injured in the Boonville church explosion were released from the hospital.

item.description: The Firefighters, part of the Banana Ball Championship League, walk into their 2026 season today.

item.title: Orland, IL, Fire Chief Quits after Four Months
item.description: The fire district board is being criticized for not telling the public about Orland Fire Chief Kevin Doyle's resignation.

item.title: Retired Newark, NJ, Firefighter Saluted for Century of Trips Around Sun
item.description: "It feels no different than when I was 68," retired Newark Capt. Ted Popovich said.

item.title: Listen: Collapse Leads to Mayday for Firefighters Trapped in Steele Creek, NC, House
